==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Kilroy Stonekin|Kilroy]] to start your [[brawling]] training.
* Defeat the [[Norn Brawler|Norn brawlers]] using your new skills.
* See Kilroy Stonekin for your reward.

===Reward===
* 100 [[Dwarf reputation point]]s
* {{skill icon|Brawling Headbutt}}

==Walkthrough==
Accepting Kilroy's quest offer will not place the [[Brass Knuckles]] in your [[inventory]] yet, but you will have it once you enter the arena and will need to equip it in your weapon slot. Your skills will be replaced with the [[Brawling]] build. The Norn Brawlers will become hostile in order. First, two single brawlers will face you, then a pair and finally the last three. Your health is partially refilled any time you defeat a brawler, and the next set does not turn hostile until you have defeated all the previous group.

Although the pair and trio of Norn Brawlers move to the center of the arena as if they were a group, they actually are not together as a team and using a [[longbow]]/[[flatbow]] or slowly moving towards them from the side can help you pull just one at a time.
